column1: 001|London|Tower Bridge|United Kingdom|Two neo-Gothic stone towers, upper walkways and suspended blue bridge spans over the Thames; a historic sailing boat below.
002|London|Tower of London|United Kingdom|The square Norman White Tower with four corner turrets rising behind a medieval curtain wall.

004|Stirling|Stirling Castle|United Kingdom|Scottish Renaissance palace buildings and battlements on a dramatic rocky hill.
005|York|York Minster|United Kingdom|Gothic cathedral with a broad west facade, paired towers and a tall central crossing tower.
006|Paris|Notre Dame|France|The recognizable west facade with two square Gothic towers, rose window and the Seine in the foreground.
007|Paris|Eiffel Tower|France|The distinctive open iron lattice tower in daylight above a historic Paris skyline; no night light display.
008|Versailles|Palace of Versailles|France|Long classical palace facade, formal garden axis and a central ornamental fountain.
009|Mont Saint Michel|Abbey Island|France|A tidal island topped by a steep medieval abbey spire, clustered houses and reflective shallow water.
010|Chartres|Chartres Cathedral|France|A French Gothic west facade with two visibly different spires, a rose window and soaring stone arches.

014|Amsterdam|Canal Houses|Netherlands|A harmonious row of narrow brick canal houses with varied gables, arched bridge and still canal reflections.
015|Utrecht|Dom Tower|Netherlands|A freestanding tall Gothic church tower above traditional Dutch canal-side houses.
016|Cologne|Cologne Cathedral|Germany|The unmistakable immense Gothic cathedral with two richly detailed pointed spires.
017|Heidelberg|Heidelberg Castle|Germany|Romantic red sandstone castle ruins above the Neckar river and old stone bridge.

019|Lubeck|Holsten Gate|Germany|Two broad round brick towers with conical roofs joined by a late Gothic gatehouse.
020|Hohenschwangau|Neuschwanstein Castle|Germany|White romantic castle towers and blue slate roofs rising above wooded Bavarian mountain cliffs.

022|Krakow|Saint Marys Basilica|Poland|A brick Gothic church on the market square with two different-height towers and a crown-like spire.

027|Rome|Pantheon|Italy|The classical columned portico, triangular pediment and large ancient low dome behind it.
028|Vatican City|Saint Peters Basilica|Vatican City|The grand Renaissance dome and classical basilica facade seen above the sweeping colonnaded square.

033|Milan|Milan Cathedral|Italy|A luminous white Gothic facade with countless pinnacles, fine tracery and pointed arches.

036|Athens|Parthenon|Greece|A recognizable ancient Doric temple with fluted columns and a partially preserved triangular pediment on the Acropolis.
037|Delphi|Tholos of Delphi|Greece|Three surviving slender classical columns on a circular temple foundation against a mountain valley.

049|Sintra|Pena Palace|Portugal|A romantic hilltop palace with red and ochre yellow towers, crenellations and forested hills.

053|Istanbul|Galata Tower|Turkey|A cylindrical medieval stone tower topped by a conical roof above traditional clustered city houses.

057|Giza|Pyramids and Sphinx|Egypt|The three ancient pyramids and the recognizable limestone Sphinx in warm desert light.

062|Tunis|Historic Medina|Tunisia|A warm-toned historic North African medina with white houses, courtyard rooftops and a square mosque minaret.

065|Isfahan|Si o se pol Bridge|Iran|A long historic Persian stone bridge with rhythmic double-level pointed arches reflected in a river.

071|Jaipur|Hawa Mahal|India|A pink sandstone honeycomb palace facade with many small projecting lattice windows in stacked tiers.

082|Kyoto|Kiyomizu dera|Japan|A historic timber temple with a broad curved roof and a tall open wooden veranda above forested slopes.
083|Nara|Todai ji|Japan|The immense historic wooden Great Buddha Hall with a broad curved tiled roof and dignified entrance.

085|Matsumoto|Matsumoto Castle|Japan|A black-and-white historic Japanese castle with layered roofs reflected in a moat, a small red bridge nearby.
